name: Barbarian Axe Twirling chains Throw Weapon, Javelin Toss, Gutspiller, and Berserker Axe to 2 additional enemies (#13667)
contract: Axe Twirling (800401) adds SPELLMOD_JUMP_TARGETS +2 (BasePoints 1 + DieSides 1) over EffectSpellClassMask
(262144, 786436, 0), covering Throw Weapon (804136, 806876-806881, 572614), Javelin Toss (504217), Gutspiller
(805832, 806882-806887), and Berserker Axe (804138, 503408-503414). Four DBC defects broke multi-target hits:
(1) Throw Weapon carried ChainTarget 1 on effect 0 (NORMALIZED_WEAPON_DMG) but 0 on effect 1
(WEAPON_PERCENT_DAMAGE), so target 3 received only effect 0 which EffectWeaponDmg defers to effect 1 (0 damage);
(2) Javelin Toss carried ChainTarget 0 on both weapon-damage effects, capping 0 + 2 at 1 additional target;
(3) Gutspiller lacked SPELL_ATTR4_BOUNCY_CHAIN_MISSILES (0x40000), capping SearchChainTargets at 7.5 yd from the
primary target instead of bouncing 7.5 yd per jump; (4) Berserker Axe's triggered missile 806960 carried
RangeIndex 4 (30 yd) instead of 13 (Anywhere), failing CheckRange on chained targets beyond 30 yd from the caster.
With targets at 24, 29 (5 yd from t0), and 35 yd (6 yd from t1, 11 yd from t0, > 30 yd from caster), all four
abilities must damage and apply their debuffs to all three targets while Axe Twirling is active, and Throw Weapon
must hit only t0 without Axe Twirling.

Wait for 2500 + 500 ms ranged cast and missile flight
CONTROL: Throw Weapon hits t0 without Axe Twirling
CONTROL: Throw Weapon does not chain to t1 without Axe Twirling
CONTROL: Throw Weapon does not chain to t2 without Axe Twirling
Activate Axe Twirling (800401)
Axe Twirling buff is active
Throw Weapon with Axe Twirling active
Wait for 3000 ms ranged cast and 35 yd flight
Throw Weapon damages t0 with Axe Twirling
Throw Weapon damages t1 with Axe Twirling
DISCRIMINATING: Throw Weapon damages t2 (effect 1 now chains to target 3)
Learn Sen'jin's Guidance (707661) for Javelin Toss (504217)
Javelin Toss (504217) is learned
Javelin Toss with Axe Twirling active
Wait for 3000 ms ranged cast and 35 yd flight
Javelin Toss damages t0 with Axe Twirling
Javelin Toss damages t1 with Axe Twirling
DISCRIMINATING: Javelin Toss damages t2 (ChainTarget 1 + 2 = 3 targets)
Gutspiller Rank 7 (806887) with Axe Twirling active
Gutspiller bleed applies to t0
Gutspiller bleed applies to t1
DISCRIMINATING: Gutspiller bounces to t2 at 11 yd from t0 via SPELL_ATTR4_BOUNCY_CHAIN_MISSILES

Gutspiller periodic bleed damages t0
Gutspiller periodic bleed damages t1

Guts Spilled (520577) damages t0
Guts Spilled (520577) damages t1

Berserker Axe Rank 8 (503414) with Axe Twirling active
Wait for 806960 missiles over 35 yd flight
Berserker Axe hits t0 with both axes
Berserker Axe hits t1 with both axes
